behavior: Assessment navigation validates standalone-practice eligibility before creating a new presentation, including out-of-order navigation to a previously reserved question.
Ordinary lesson/review continuation validates a new practice-question presentation without applying the new policy to saved answers or instructional examples.
Existing queue preparation replaces stale never-started multipart review and assessment routes; the stale route is retained and its task is locked.
coverage: Unstarted stale review and assessment routes cannot start and are replaced without learner progress changes.
Unvisited multipart assessment questions cannot be presented by navigating out of order.
Already-presented multipart answers remain draftable, gradable, revisitable, pausable, resumable, and readable in completed history.
A future multipart review slot cannot be presented; the saved current answer is preserved.
Full assignment playback and shared context tests pass.
migrationRequirement: Any already-started review containing a future unpresented multipart slot needs a one-time route repair before continuing beyond that slot. The immutable route is not silently resampled, and completed answers and assessment scoring are not rewritten. Root owns the live fixed-basis route audit and any data migration.
